controller.title: Debug Simulator
controller.subtitle: Test participant connection, readiness, and handovers without the Unity application.
controller.noTrialWarning: Start a trial first via Study → Experiment → Overview → Start Trial, then the handover simulator becomes available. Connection and readiness can already be set now.

panels.connectionDesc: Simulates player join and heartbeat. Disconnecting stops the heartbeat; the backend marks the player as offline after ~10 s.
panels.readinessDesc: Sets or removes readiness per slot. The trial overview checks this state before a trial can be started.
panels.handoverDesc: Generates a random handover every 2 seconds with realistic timestamps. Requires an active trial with at least 2 participants.

connection.heartbeatInfo: Heartbeat sent every 2 s. After disconnecting, the backend marks the player as offline after ~10 s.

handover.minParticipantsHint: At least 2 participants in the trial required.
